No road-building or byway-campaign history is cached. The middle paragraph uses forest establishment and landscape history instead.

New savannah moment describes the corridor’s northern forest portion, not a named pullout; no precise location is supported, so at is omitted. Sumatra stays short because its cache offers little place history.
Prospect Bluff history relies on Wikipedia; no underlying archival or tribal source is cached. Tribe wording follows that page. Conflicting casualty counts on the page are omitted.

Current tagline’s entirely flat terrain is corrected to flat-to-gently rolling. Current woodpecker endangered status is omitted because Forest Service and Wikipedia use different status terms. Undated current population of 148 is omitted rather than presenting a census count as current.
